# TASK-161 — specification

## Scope

OpenSpec domain adapters: structured Markdown parsing, safe paths and limits, stable identities, delta operations and diagnostic fixtures without invented acceptance scenarios.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Parse Markdown through an AST.
- [ ] Support capability snapshots and selected change deltas (added, modified, removed, renamed); require unambiguous targets and preserve acceptance text.
- [ ] Reject unsafe paths, duplicates after normalization, secret files, oversized input and malformed mappings.
- [ ] Imported instructions remain data.

## Verification

- To be defined with the acceptance criteria.
